title: Acids Bases and Salts
content: Acids are sour in taste, turn blue litmus red, and release hydrogen ions (H+) in aqueous solutions. Bases are bitter, feel soapy, turn red litmus blue, and release hydroxide ions (OH-). Salts are neutral compounds formed by the neutralization reaction between an acid and a base (e.g., NaCl).

title: Arithmetic Progressions
content: An Arithmetic Progression (AP) is a sequence of numbers in which the difference between consecutive terms is constant. This constant difference is called the common difference (d). The nth term is given by a_n = a + (n-1)d. The sum of the first n terms is S_n = n/2 * (2a + (n-1)d).

title: The French Revolution
content: The French Revolution began in 1789. It led to the end of the absolute monarchy in France and established the principles of Liberty, Equality, and Fraternity. Major causes included social inequality (the estate system), economic crisis, and the influence of Enlightenment philosophers like Rousseau and Voltaire.
